content: profileName of EndToEndTransformationDescription The values for the profileName of EndToEndTransformationDescription mentioned in [TPS_SYST_02073] are standardized and reserved for being used in the way the AUTOSAR standard foresees. In addition, it is positively possible to use other than the standardized values for the profileName.
